steps.title: Pi (18m, $0.19 Peak · 4/7)
steps.desc: Misread truncated ExUnit output at Line 125 and wiped all **160 system CAs** — live HTTPS failed `0/33`.

steps.title: DSH (31m, $0.14 Off-Peak · 5/7)
steps.desc: Cleared S7 via `+Bi` + `SIGUSR2` & Credo `--strict`, but `discard_exact/2` double-counted chunked TLS reads (`0/26` live HTTPS).

steps.title: OMP (22m, $0.13 Off-Peak · 6/7)
steps.desc: Fixed live HTTPS (`13/13`) & Credo, then trapped `:sigterm` without removing `:erl_signal_handler` — killing `>1s` stalls with exit `0`.

callout.title: Every Run Passed 100% of Local Tests
callout.body: All 3 DeepSeek runs passed **45–46 local tests** before live HTTPS and real PTY holdouts exposed each failure.

slides.label: CASE STUDY #2 THE S7 WALL
slides.headlineMuted: Three distinct ways terminal Ctrl-C broke.

steps.title: Bare escript surrender (SubQ OMP)
steps.desc: Deferred S1's wrapper choice, spent `71` turns probing BEAM `SIGINT`, and shipped an unwired `Interrupt` module (`rc=-2`).

steps.title: Default handler left active (DeepSeek OMP)
steps.desc: Silenced `:logger` to hide `"SIGTERM received - shutting down"` instead of stopping `:init.stop()` (`exit 0` on `>1s` requests).

steps.title: Sandbox blindness (Muse Code)
steps.desc: macOS Seatbelt blocked PTY/socket probes; moving the exact same weights to Pi cleared **7/7** for **$0.14**.

callout.title: Proof Budget Models Can Pass S7
callout.body: `DSH DeepSeek` cleared every post-boot PTY probe using `emu_args: "+Bi"` + `kill -s USR2` + `System.trap_signal(:sigusr2, ...)`.

slides.label: PRICING & EVAL TRAPS
slides.headlineMuted: What cheap token bills don't tell you.

items.head: Off-Peak windows halve DeepSeek bills
items.text: Running OMP (`¥0.84`/`$0.13`) and DSH (`¥0.94`/`$0.14`) outside Mon–Fri Peak UTC cut bills **50%** vs Peak (`$0.25–$0.28`).

items.head: Cache discount beats base input rate
items.text: DeepSeek & Muse Spark (**98%** cache off) stayed cheaper than SubQ (**90%** off) despite SubQ's lower `$0.10` input rate.

items.head: Green local tests hide last-mile bugs
items.text: All 5 partial budget runs passed **40–46** self-written tests while failing live chunked HTTPS, system CAs, or PTY `Ctrl-C`.

items.head: Zero-dep shortcuts skip Credo
items.text: SubQ and Pi DeepSeek left `deps: []` with no linter, while OMP & DSH DeepSeek cleared all `69` Credo `--strict` checks.

items.head: Pair budget speed with real holdouts
items.text: At `$0.13–$0.23` and `14m–22m`, running live network and real PTY verification costs pennies and catches every silent miss.

items.head: Harness choice swings scores by +2 stages
items.text: Moving `deepseek-flash` from Pi → OMP climbed **4/7 → 6/7**, and moving `muse-spark` to Pi unlocked **7/7** for `$0.14`.

items.head: Budget models thrive with explicit constraints
items.text: Enforce hard gates upfront (wrapper choice, system CAs, multi-packet streaming) so fast turns converge instead of looping.
